About HappyAnts

Building a smarter hospitality ecosystem.

HappyAnts Hospitality Services Private Limited is a hospitality and tourism company focused on property management, accommodation services, destination experiences, and travel-related coordination.

We work with property owners, accommodation providers, tourism businesses, and service partners to help hospitality assets reach their potential. Our approach combines the enduring values of hospitality—trust, personal attention, and dependable service—with modern technology and structured operations.

Our vision

To build a connected hospitality ecosystem where property owners, travellers, and local businesses can grow together.

TrustServiceInnovationPartnershipResponsible Tourism
Company profile

A hospitality partner built around people, properties, and possibility.

HappyAnts Hospitality Services Private Limited is building an integrated hospitality and travel-services ecosystem. We work across property operations, accommodation, destination experiences, and non-clinical travel coordination—bringing service standards and digital tools together to make each journey easier to manage.

Medical Tourism · Patient Support

Medical Tourism in Bengaluru, India

HappyAnts Hospitality Services Private Limited works with established hospitals and healthcare partners in Bengaluru to help patients and their families navigate the practical aspects of accessing medical treatment. We help simplify the arrangements around a healthcare visit, from initial hospital enquiries and appointment coordination to travel, accommodation, and local support.

✚

Hospital connections & appointment coordination

We facilitate introductions to our hospital partners and help coordinate consultation requests, appointment scheduling, and communication with relevant hospital teams.

▤

Treatment enquiry support

We help patients communicate their general requirements to hospital contacts and understand the next administrative steps. Medical assessments and treatment recommendations are made by qualified healthcare professionals.

✈

Travel & accommodation

For patients travelling from other Indian cities or overseas, we can help coordinate accommodation, airport transfers, local transportation, and practical arrangements for accompanying family members, subject to availability.

♡

Support for patients & families

From the initial enquiry to visit planning, our goal is to provide responsive communication and practical coordination, helping patients and attendants navigate unfamiliar arrangements with greater clarity.
